issue: Built-in driver registration is not implemented: `discover_drivers` requires callers to supply an arbitrary built-in iterable, and the public driver package defines no registry or factory that registers Claude by its unique name, so production discovery can return no Claude driver
reason: The accepted design explicitly defines discover_drivers(builtins: Iterable[DriverPlugin]); _register_driver registers each driver by unique name and checks duplicates. tests/drivers/test_registry.py:10 exercises Claude registration through a closure. Automatic supervisor composition belongs to PRD 00007; an implicit provider import into neutral discovery would break the boundary.

issue: LaunchSpec.env is the child's whole environment (OwnedProcess.spawn passes it straight to Popen; test_claude_process checks that HOST_ONLY_MARKER is None in the child), and ClaudeDriver sets only CLAUDE_UNATTENDED, CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS and WARDEN_UNATTENDED. With no PATH, Popen looks up a bare `command=["claude"]` only in /bin:/usr/bin, so launch fails with FileNotFoundError while probe() (shutil.which with the host PATH) still reports healthy. The agent's Bash tool also gets no PATH/HOME, so mise, git and uv go missing. The source runner.py child_env() passed the full host env through, dropping only host markers, and the PRD says "environment additions". Confirmed by reading the code; the fake-claude test hides it because it uses an absolute path
reason: The accepted design states LaunchSpec.env is an overlay and its Data flow step 2 assigns deliberate host-environment merging to the later supervisor. OwnedProcess.spawn accepts the final environment, so the test passes a self-contained fake environment deliberately. No production supervisor caller exists in this PRD. Keep provider code from copying os.environ; clarify overlay composition in the protocol documentation task.

issue: A hand-rolled 1 MiB-per-driver Bloom filter guards against message-id replays after more than 4096 other message ids, which may never happen in Claude stream-json
reason: The committed task-7 decision explicitly requires a bounded exact cache and fixed Bloom filter to suppress evicted replays. The requirement is deduplication with bounded memory, not proof that a current captured run exceeds 4096 identities. Deleting the filter on absence of such logs would reintroduce a required replay failure. Inferred/possibly undercounted usage is fixed under O6.

issue: The prompt is the last positional argument with no `--` before it, so a prompt starting with "-" would be parsed as a CLI option

issue: Spec says normalized events must redact environment values.
